  - Persisted artifacts and binaries: collect file paths, hashes, and signatures for any dropped binaries, tools, or scripts referenced in the decoded PowerShell or in process command lines; check reputation. (Tool: EDR file collection / hash lookup)
  - Supplementary telemetry: fetch network connections and parent PowerShell network activity around 14:32:4x to detect C2, and check PowerShell logs (ScriptBlock/ModuleLogging) and Windows Event Log for scheduled tasks or service changes. (Tool: EDR network/session logs + Windows event queries)

- Next action decision points
  - If decoded script or LSASS access shows credential-dumping behavior or unknown unsigned binaries: isolate host and collect volatile memory (or LSASS memory dump) and full forensic artifacts.
  - If activity appears legitimate and owner/IT confirms: document findings and whitelist the benign process with continued monitoring.
